summary: @servicetitan/standalone-ui preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package's declared preinstall script runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun-v1.3.13) into a temp directory, unzips it, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated bundle (rotated string arrays, hex-named identifiers, character-code tables) marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`; no source file under src/ references it, and it executes only via the Bun-based loader. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers and per-function property-name maps. The package is advertised as a React UI helpers library, a purpose that has no need for a bundled alternate JavaScript runtime or an opaque install-time payload. The pattern — fetching a second runtime to execute an obfuscated blob at install time — evades scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code and results in arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine during `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
